author: BoldAndBrash
body:
Mod: Salmon... I like it. Although i think itd be better a little darker.

Sr (Managers were turned into srs): Red. Perfect

Directors: Gold looks nice and really pops out.

Junior: Cyan, looks great!


What do you guy think about the new name colors?

Sorry if this is some how considered spam, btw.
